newsitem.title: MEXICO: TV Azteca IPO priced at $18.25 per ADS - sources.
newsitem.headline: TV Azteca IPO priced at $18.25 per ADS - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering for Mexican broadcaster TV Azteca was priced at $18.25 per ADS, market sources said.
"The price is $18.25 per ADS but there is still some discussion about the exchange rate to be used for the price in pesos," a source involved in the placement told Reuters.
Another market source close to the deal confirmed the initial price of $18.25 per ADS.

Some 11,017,537 ordinary shares, or CPOs, were being offered as part of the global primary offering, while an additional 149,060,648 were up for grabs in a secondary offering. The shares were due to start trading on Friday on both the New York and Mexican stock exchanges.
There were four CPO shares per ADS, according to the company.
Azteca is Mexico's second largest broadcaster. Since it was privatized in 1993, it has gained market share from its larger rival Grupo Televisa .
